pillars.name: Création de personnages
pillars.rule: The player creates a person who belongs in the world; historical characters remain authored and distinct.

pillars.name: Gore systémique et conséquences corporelles
pillars.rule: Violence must connect to body zones, injuries, trauma, dismemberment, persistent corpses or other meaningful consequences rather than decorative blood alone.

pillars.name: Philosophie et psychologie accessibles
pillars.rule: Complex human themes must be understandable through situations, characters and choices without requiring prior academic knowledge.

pillars.name: Narration forte
pillars.rule: Roguelike or roguelite structure must support a clear plot, memorable characters, mysteries, consequences and emotional progression.

pillars.name: Interconnexion des jeux
pillars.rule: Each game enriches the others through shared history, traces, institutions, objects, myths and contradictions while remaining understandable on its own.

accessibility_layers.name: Compréhension immédiate
accessibility_layers.goal: Understand who suffers, who wants what, what the danger is and what choice is being asked.

accessibility_layers.name: Interprétation
accessibility_layers.goal: Understand why characters disagree and which values conflict.

accessibility_layers.name: Profondeur historique et philosophique
accessibility_layers.goal: Connect events to the Three Awakenings, Concorde, historical memory, ancient texts and other games.

design_target: Prefer systems that express several pillars at once.
